units.source_text: 伞铺女在罗连被破门后不久，就生下了一个儿子，

en.t: Not long after Lorenzo was excommunicated, the umbrella seller's daughter gave birth to a son,

units.source_text: 伞翁虽然很是惊诧，但是看幼孙稚嫩的面容，

en.t: and though the old umbrella seller was greatly astonished, when he looked at his infant grandson's tender face,

units.source_text: 也不再生气，于是和女儿一起抚养，抱着哄着，当成了生活的乐趣。

en.t: he was no longer angry, and so he raised the child together with his daughter, holding him, soothing him, and making him the joy of their life.

units.source_text: 最为奇怪的是法众西美昂，

en.t: The strangest of all was Simeon, one of the faithful,

units.source_text: 这么一个力敌恶魔的汉子，听说伞女生下儿子之后，

en.t: a man strong enough to contend with demons, who, after hearing that the umbrella seller's daughter had borne a son,

units.source_text: 经常当伞翁家里，用巨臂抱着小孩，看着他熟悉的容颜，

en.t: would often go to the old umbrella seller's house, hold the child in his great arms, and gaze at that familiar face,

units.source_text: 泫然欲泣，这是因为他一直没有忘记兄弟罗连的缘故。

en.t: his eyes brimming as though he were about to weep, because he had never forgotten his brother Lorenzo.

units.source_text: 伞铺的女儿自从罗连被赶出教堂之后，

en.t: Ever since Lorenzo had been driven out of the church, the umbrella seller's daughter

units.source_text: 常常面露怨恨之色，对于西美昂从来没有过好脸色。

en.t: often wore a resentful expression and never once showed Simeon a kind face.
